steps.description: Filter genes to those with >=5 counts (lowered floor appropriate for 3'-tag library depth per R-0080) in at least 3 samples (smallest group size). Build a DESeqDataSet with design ~condition, set 'control' as the explicit reference level (do not rely on alphabetical default), and run DESeq2's median-of-ratios normalization and Wald test. Import counts as raw integers with NO gene-length correction and NO countsFromAbundance scaling, since this is a 3' tag library where read count does not depend on transcript length (TPM/FPKM are not applicable units here). Apply apeglm shrinkage to the treated-vs-control log2 fold change. Produce MA plot and dispersion plot as fit diagnostics. Flag any genes with NA p-values from Cook's-distance outlier detection (n=3/group triggers NA-flagging rather than replacement) and report the p-value histogram shape before adjustment.

plan.title: Liver drug-treated vs control: DESeq2 DE + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: 3' QuantSeq tag-seq counts (12,000 genes x 6 liver samples, 3 treated vs 3 control, single batch) go through standard DESeq2 differential expression, adapted for the 3'-tag library type (no gene-length correction, no TPM/FPKM) and for the low-replicate warning (n=3/group, low power per rule R-0017). Track 1 runs sample-structure QC, a minimal count filter tuned for 3'-tag depth, DESeq2 normalization/modeling with an explicit control reference level, the Wald test with apeglm shrinkage, and BH multiple-testing correction. Track 2 takes the full ranked gene list (Wald statistic) into fgsea preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome (both staged locally for human). A final report step consolidates DE tables, fit diagnostics, enrichment results with leading-edge genes, and the mandatory power/reproducibility caveats for a 3-replicate design.

steps.method: vst(blind) + PCA + sample distance heatmap + library sizes
Low count filter, floor 5 (3prime tag adjustment), min samples = smallest group (3)
~condition, explicit reference level = control, raw counts no length correction
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald stat, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
Full report with power caveat, MA/dispersion plots, leading edge, reproducibility record
